triple_constraint.standards_of_creation: Five-layer bar; no stubs; ADAM+EVE dual witness; verified live-fetched CA statutes; federal statutes from training knowledge verified=false
triple_constraint.standard_of_care: Disabled persons navigating employment, courts, and medical systems often cannot identify when their disability-based exclusion is a legal violation. The law creates rights that require professional identification to activate.

critical_disability_findings.aja_per_se: CIV §51(f) and §54(c): ADA violation = per se Unruh/DPA violation; CA statutory damages ($4,000/§52; $1,000/§54.3) attach automatically
critical_disability_findings.interactive_process_mandatory: GOV §12940(n): employer MUST engage in interactive process; failure to engage = independent FEHA violation regardless of accommodation outcome
critical_disability_findings.record_of_disability: GOV §12926(j): discrimination based on RECORD of disability (e.g., credit report showing 'retired' after industrial injury) is covered — employer cannot use past disability record against employee
critical_disability_findings.no_exhaustion_for_unruh: CIV §51/§54 claims: NO administrative exhaustion required; direct Superior Court filing; strategically valuable for immediate relief
critical_disability_findings.title_ii_courts: 42 USC §12131: ADA Title II requires state courts to accommodate disabled persons; court proceedings are public services; failure = ADA + CIV §51 per se
